comments: Very interesting survey, makes you think!

The memory checks are necessary, but I think one being the names (with options similar to the actual names) vs. one questioning something actually relevant to the scenario (the wedding one) feels unbalanced and I can see people getting names wrong seeing how irrelevant the names are other than differentiating which person is which in each scenario.
Use a better scale than maximally formal and moderately intimate for the relationships. Using coworkers, friends, lovers, etc would suffice and make simpler.
It was interesting!  Although it was challenging to remember the correct names foods for each scenario. I really struggled to get the attention checks correct (if I did!)!
